exposure: Category II fetal heart rate tracings
frequency/severity of fetal heart rate decelerations
rate of progression of acidosis (rapid vs. slow)
cohort: The cohort consists of infants with severe cerebral palsy born at >=34 weeks' gestation between 2009 and 2014 in Japan, presumed to have an intrapartum onset of hypoxic-ischemic insult based on fetal heart rate patterns and umbilical arterial BD_ecf >= 12 mEq/L.
finding: Fetal BD_ecf reached 12 mEq/L within 1 hour of recurrent fetal heart rate decelerations in the rapid progression group and within 3 hours in the slow progression group, suggesting that operative intervention may benefit slow progression cases if decelerations persist for longer than 2 hours.
